apps.name: Prisma
apps.subtitle: Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: Prisma is a fork of Air with simpler JIT setup on iOS 26 and in-app language switching. These are nightly test builds, so expect bugs. Not available in mainland China.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Prisma uses the local network to find and communicate with AltServer and LAN servers, and to enable multiplayer connectivity via Terracotta (compatible with HMCL/FCL/ZL2).
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Prisma uses the microphone to enable support for voice chat mods.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Prisma uses the photo library add-only access to save Bing daily wallpapers and the donate QR image you choose to save.
